definitions.explanation: The pressure of blood against the walls of the arteries.

examples.japanese: {血圧|けつあつ}を{測|はか}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had my blood pressure measured.

examples.japanese: {血圧|けつあつ}が{高|たか}いので{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm taking medication because my blood pressure is high.

examples.japanese: {塩分|えんぶん}の{取|と}りすぎは{血圧|けつあつ}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: Consuming too much salt raises blood pressure.

notes:
{血圧|けつあつ} is an important medical term.

Types of blood pressure:
- {上|うえ}の{血圧|けつあつ} / {最高|さいこう}{血圧|けつあつ} (systolic blood pressure)
- {下|した}の{血圧|けつあつ} / {最低|さいてい}{血圧|けつあつ} (diastolic blood pressure)

Conditions:
- {高|こう}{血圧|けつあつ} (high blood pressure, hypertension)
- {低|てい}{血圧|けつあつ} (low blood pressure, hypotension)

Common collocations:
- {血圧|けつあつ}を{測|はか}る (to measure blood pressure)
- {血圧|けつあつ}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (blood pressure is high/low)
- {血圧|けつあつ}{計|けい} (blood pressure monitor)
- {血圧|けつあつ}を{下|さ}げる/{上|あ}げる (to lower/raise blood pressure)
